# Introduction

Prior work established the effect (Smith et al., 2019). The mechanism proves
definitively that the intervention works, and all studies show the same
benefit.

# Results

The primary analysis was significant, t(38) = 2.50, p = 0.20. A secondary
comparison showed F(2, 40) = 5.00, p = 0.30. The prevalence was 34% in 2020.
Mortality fell by 5% in the treatment arm [3]. A correlation of r = 1.7 was
observed between dose and response. Mean symptom score was 3.15 (N = 4).

We used the QRNN-X algorithm to model the data. The result is reported in
doi: 10.9999/not-a-real-suffix and PMID: 1234567890.

# Discussion

These findings are certain and beyond doubt. No study has ever reported a
contrary result.
